prerequisites.required: Basic typing and computer navigation skills
prerequisites.recommended: Familiarity with web browsers and email

overview.positioning: The comprehensive core skills certification for modern office administration.
overview.short_description: Master the essential Microsoft and Google productivity suites to manage documents, data, and presentations efficiently.
what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Format professional corporate documents and reports in Word/Docs
Manage and analyze operational data using Excel/Sheets formulas
Design and deliver engaging presentations in PowerPoint
Organize cloud storage, calendars, and emails effectively

why_now.industry_shift: The expectation for digital literacy in administrative roles has never been higher.
why_now.ai_impact: Understanding core software functionality is required before utilizing AI assistants.
why_now.business_demand: Every corporate office requires professionals who can efficiently manage digital workflows.
why_now.career_opportunity: A strong foundation in these tools is the gateway to almost all office-based careers.

learning_outcomes: ORGANIZE: Business data for easy reporting and tracking
PRESENT: Information clearly through slide decks

stages.name: Communication
stages.desc: Managing emails and scheduling in Calendar

stages.name: Documentation
stages.desc: Drafting minutes and reports in Word

stages.name: Tracking
stages.desc: Logging expenses and data in Excel

business_use_cases.business_problem: Disorganized files and slow document creation
business_use_cases.approach: Implement templates and cloud organization best practices

best_practices: Use Styles in Word rather than manual formatting
Never merge cells in Excel unless absolutely necessary
Keep presentation slides visual, not text-heavy

common_mistakes.mistake: Using spaces to align text in Word
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Lack of knowledge about tabs and indents
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Use the ruler, tabs, and paragraph settings for alignment

career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: A portfolio of formatted business documents and data sheets

freelance_applications.client_workflow: Receive raw content -> Format & Organize -> Deliver finalized files

final_deliverables: A complete administrative portfolio demonstrating proficiency across Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

assessment.criteria: Formatting accuracy, formula correctness, and visual design quality

faq.question: Does this cover both Microsoft and Google tools?
faq.answer: Yes, we teach the core concepts using Microsoft Office and show the equivalents in Google Workspace.

faq.question: I know basic Word, is this too basic for me?
faq.answer: The course covers advanced formatting, mail merge, and templates which most self-taught users miss.

lessons.what_learner_does: Formats a raw text file into a structured report

lessons.what_is_taught: Creating tables, tab stops, and indentations

lessons.what_is_taught: Connecting Excel data to Word documents

lessons.what_is_taught: Navigating sheets, formatting cells, basic math
SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, Basic IF

lessons.lesson_title: Visualizing with Charts and Pivot Tables
lessons.what_is_taught: Basic charts and intro to Pivot Tables
lessons.what_learner_does: Creates a monthly expense summary chart

Editing the Slide Master for consistent branding

lessons.what_is_taught: Appropriate animation use and Presenter View
lessons.why_it_matters: Controls flow of information during delivery
lessons.what_learner_does: Adds professional transitions to a pitch deck

Scheduling, invitations, and managing multiple calendars
